div.div:
Gaps (not drawn):
• Every call between services goes through Dapr service invocation over HTTP (AD-3); the protocol is left off the arrows to keep them legible.
• Data stores and external Azure services are on the companion diagram c4-containers-stores.
• Which service calls are made for the Compare view's second verdict run is stated (AD-11), but the screen that triggers it is not designed: no UX documents exist.
Each element's source is in grey under its name and in its tooltip.
